frame: van space = Unity frame of the prefab root Van (x right, y up, z forward, metres, ground y = 0); body frame of VAN3_CONTRACT.md (x forward, y left, z up) -> (-y, z, x). Every part has an identity local rotation at rest: parent-local = van space - parent origin.
rules: hinge / twist / spin: localRotation = rest * Quaternion.AngleAxis(value, rotAxis) (value in the contract units and sense: degrees, + as described; rotAxis already flipped for the left-handed frame). slide (and the pull-out travel of an item with a range): localPosition = restPosition + dir * value (metres). stretch: scale along dir from the pivot, value = the scale (x). GearLever: rotAxis = fore-aft (about body +y), rotAxis2 = side (about body +x), lift along liftDir; gears = the H pattern. Needles: angle(value) = lerp(angleMin, angleMax, (value - scaleMin) / (scaleMax - scaleMin)); turn by angle - rest. box: grab / hit box in the part frame (BoxCollider.center / size on the part).
